svg.title: Fitting the model (least squares)
svg.desc: Animated. Twelve orange dots, one per robot loop, are scattered around a blue line on a graph of speed against volts. Each dot's miss from the line is drawn as a red square whose side is the miss, so big misses make much bigger squares. The line tilts flatter, then steeper, and the bar of the squared misses added up grows each time; when the line settles back on the best fit, the bar drops to the dashed level marked least. Each miss is squared, so misses above and below the line don't cancel and big misses count most. A real run gives hundreds of samples for just a few unknowns.
svg.text: Least squares picks the line whose squared misses add up to the least.
